descriptionAr: الكورس ده مخصص للأصوات والأنماط اللي بتصعب على المتكلم العربي: طول الحركات، والضغط في الكلمات الطويلة، والـ schwa، وتجميع الحروف الساكنة، وربط الكلام، والإيقاع، والنغمة. كل درس فيه Minimal pairs، وفحص نطق، وShadowing، ومواقف شغل حقيقية. الهدف إن كلامك يبقى مفهوم من أول مرة، مش لكنة مثالية.

lessons.goalAr: تفرّق في النطق بين الحركات اللي بتغيّر المعنى: ship/sheep، full/fool، cost/coast.

read.title: Small sounds, big differences
read.text:
Arabic has three short vowels and three long ones. English has around twelve vowel sounds, and some of them change the meaning of a word completely. If you say "I will leave the site" when you mean "I will live", or "full" instead of "fool", the listener may stop and think.

The good news: you don't need a perfect accent. You need clear contrasts. Practice in pairs, slowly at first: live and leave, pull and pool, cost and coast, cut and cart. Exaggerate the length of the long vowel. Then put the words in short business sentences and say them at normal speed.
read.ar: الإنجليزي فيه حوالي 12 صوت حركة، وبعضهم بيغيّر المعنى. مش محتاج لكنة مثالية، محتاج فرق واضح بين الأزواج دي. اتمرّن ببطء ومط الحركة الطويلة، وبعدين في جمل شغل بسرعة عادية.

vocab.ex: The cost is higher this month.
The site is on the coast.
Load the cores onto the cart.

pron.explainAr: الحركة الطويلة (ː) اتمطّها ضعف القصيرة، والشفايف بتتغير: /iː/ ابتسامة، و/uː/ شفايف مدورة لقدام، و/ɑː/ بق مفتوح واسع. القصيرة مرخية وسريعة.
drills: Please change the bit before we beat the deadline.
The cost on the coast project is higher.
The schedule is full, so we'll use the second pool of technicians.
We cut the slab and loaded the cores onto the cart.

shadow.en: The cost on the coast project is higher.
Please change the drill bit.
We can still beat the deadline.
The schedule is full this week.
We'll use the second pool of technicians.
We cut the slab and loaded the cart.

listen.contextAr: تعليمات سريعة في موقع. ركّز على الكلمات المتشابهة.

lines.en: First, change the bit on machine two.
The old bit or the new one?
The new one. Then cut the opening on the east wall.
And the cores?
Put them on the cart, not in the pool area.

speak.promptAr: اقرا الأزواج دي بصوت عالي مرتين: ببطء ومط، وبعدين بسرعة عادية: bit/beat، full/fool، cost/coast، cut/cart. وبعدها قول 3 جمل من عندك فيها كلمتين منهم.
speak.model: Bit, beat. Full, fool. Cost, coast. Cut, cart. — The cost of the coast project is high. Please change the bit so we can beat the deadline. We cut the slab and used the cart.

write.taskAr: اكتب 5 جمل من شغلك، كل جملة فيها كلمتين من زوج واحد (زي cost وcoast). اقراها وسجّلها.
write.model:
1. The cost of the coast hotel project is higher than expected.
2. Please check the bit before you beat the record.
3. The schedule is full, so don't be a fool and add more jobs.
4. We cut the slab and moved the cores with the cart.
5. Pull the cable away from the pool.

lessons.goalAr: تحط الضغط صح على الكلمات الطويلة اللي بتستخدمها كل يوم: operations، development، analysis.

read.title: Stress is the shape of a word
read.text:
Native listeners recognize long words mainly by their stress pattern, not by every sound. If you say "de-VE-lop-ment" correctly, people understand you even with an accent. If you say "DE-ve-lop-ment", they may not.

Some useful patterns: words ending in -tion and -sion are stressed on the syllable just before the ending: ope-RA-tion, de-CI-sion. Words ending in -ic follow the same rule: stra-TE-gic, e-co-NO-mic. Words ending in -ity are stressed three syllables from the end: ca-PA-ci-ty, se-CU-ri-ty, QUA-li-ty.

When you learn a new word, learn its stress at the same time.
read.ar: المستمع الأصلي بيتعرف على الكلمة الطويلة من شكل الضغط فيها. قواعد مفيدة: -tion و-sion الضغط قبلها مباشرة، و-ic كمان، و-ity الضغط على المقطع التالت من الآخر. اتعلّم ضغط الكلمة مع معناها.

vocab.ex: We use analytics to track costs.

pron.explainAr: المقطع المضغوط أعلى وأطول وأوضح، والباقي بيضعف (غالبًا لصوت /ə/). الأزواج هنا نفس العيلة بس الضغط بيتنقل: PHOtograph / phoTOgraphy.
drills: Operations and business development work closely together.
The analysis improved our efficiency and capacity.
It's a strategic decision for procurement.
We use analytics to analyze the economy of each project.

shadow.en: I manage operations and business development.
The analysis shows we have spare capacity.
shadow.ar: التحليل بيوري إن عندنا طاقة زيادة.

shadow.en: Automation improved our efficiency by thirty percent.
This is a strategic client for us.
Please send the request to procurement.
We use analytics to track every project.

lines.en: This quarter, operations improved efficiency by twelve percent.
Our analysis shows spare capacity in Riyadh.
So business development will focus on two strategic clients there.
Should procurement increase stock for Riyadh?
Yes, but only after the analytics confirm demand.

questions.prompt: By how much did efficiency improve?

speak.promptAr: اشرح دورك في 40 ثانية مستخدم 5 كلمات على الأقل من القايمة، بالضغط الصح.
speak.promptEn: Describe your role using the target words.
speak.useEn: operations, development, analysis, capacity, efficiency, strategic, procurement
speak.model: I manage operations for our Egypt branch and support business development in the Gulf. I use data analysis to plan capacity and improve efficiency, and I work closely with procurement on strategic suppliers.
checklist: الضغط كان أوضح من باقي الكلام

write.taskAr: اعمل قايمة شخصية بـ 10 كلمات طويلة بتستخدمها في شغلك، واكتب كل كلمة بالمقطع المضغوط بحروف كبيرة، وجملة ليها.

2. re-con-ci-li-A-tion – Monthly reconciliation is done by the 5th.
3. in-VEN-to-ry – Inventory is checked weekly.
4. de-LI-ve-ry – Delivery takes two days.

lessons.titleEn: The Schwa: The Most Common Sound
lessons.goalAr: تضعّف المقاطع غير المضغوطة لصوت /ə/ علشان كلامك يبقى أخف وأقرب للطبيعي.

read.title: Weak sounds make strong English
read.text:
The most common vowel in English is not a, e, i, o or u. It's the schwa, a short, relaxed sound like a quick "uh". It appears in unstressed syllables: the a in about, the o in today, the er in manager.

Many Arabic speakers pronounce every syllable fully: "ma-na-jer", "to-day". This makes speech sound heavy and slow, and it hides the stressed syllable. Try relaxing the weak syllables: "MAN-uh-juh", "tuh-DAY".

Small words do the same in sentences: to, for, and, of, can usually become weak: "I need tuh talk tuh the manager".
read.ar: أكتر صوت حركة في الإنجليزي هو الـ schwa /ə/: صوت قصير مرخي زي "أه" سريعة، في المقاطع غير المضغوطة. لما تنطق كل مقطع كامل كلامك بيتقل ويضيع الضغط. رخّي المقاطع الضعيفة والكلمات الصغيرة زي to وfor وand وof.

vocab.ex: I need to talk to the manager.

pron.explainAr: الـ schwa صوت قصير جدًا والبق مرخي، من غير شفايف مدورة ولا ابتسامة. مش هتلاقيه في المقطع المضغوط أبدًا. في الكلمات الصغيرة: can ضعيفة = kən، بس لو مضغوطة في آخر الجملة (Yes, we CAN) بتبقى kæn.
drills: I need to talk to the manager about the problem.
We can support the contractor today.
It's about two kilometers from the site.
A cup of tea for the team, please.

shadow.en: I need to talk to the manager.
We can start today.
It's about two days of work.
The contractor has a small problem.
We'll support your team for a week.
Yes, we can.

listen.contextAr: اسمع الكلمات الصغيرة الضعيفة. حاول تكتب الجملة الأولى قبل ما تفتح النص.

lines.en: Can you send a team to the site today?
We can send two people for about four hours.
Is that enough for the problem on level one?
Yes, it is. And our manager can support you on the phone.

speak.promptAr: قول الجمل دي مرة بنطق كل مقطع كامل، ومرة بالـ schwa، وسجّل الاتنين وقارن: I need to talk to the manager about the problem. / We can support the contractor today.
speak.model: I need tuh talk tuh the MAN-i-juh uh-BOUT the PROB-lum. We kən suh-PORT the kun-TRAC-tuh tuh-DAY.

write.taskAr: خد إيميل إنجليزي كتبته قبل كده، وعلّم على المقاطع اللي فيها schwa في 5 كلمات، واقراه بصوت عالي.
write.model:
Dear (ə) Sara,
Thank you for (fə) the update. We can (kən) start tod(ə)ay … The contract(ə)or confirmed the (ðə) schedule …

lessons.titleAr: تجميع الحروف الساكنة من غير حركة زيادة
lessons.goalAr: تنطق كلمات زي street وsplit وproject من غير ما تزوّد حركة في الأول أو النص ("إستريت" أو "بروجيكت").

read.title: No extra vowels
read.text:
Arabic doesn't start words with two consonants together, so many Arabic speakers add a vowel: "is-treet", "is-pring", or "pe-roject". English listeners usually understand, but it makes speech sound slower and less clear.

The trick is to start the first consonant softly and move straight to the next one, with no breath in between. Practise from the end of the word backwards: -eet, -treet, street. Or hold the s like a snake, then add the rest: ssss-treet.

Common business words with clusters: schedule, structure, strategy, split, scope, scan, project, proposal, price, client, sprint.
read.ar: العربي ما بيبدأش الكلمة بحرفين ساكنين، فبنزوّد حركة: "إستريت" و"بروجيكت". الحل: ابدأ الحرف الأول خفيف وادخل على اللي بعده على طول. اتمرّن من آخر الكلمة لأولها، أو طوّل الـ s زي الصفير وبعدين كمّل.

vocab.ex: Let's split the work into phases.

pron.focus: Clusters — st, sp, sk, str, spl, pr, kl
pron.explainAr: ما تقولش "إس" قبل s، وما تحطش حركة بين p وr. جرّب: قول "eet" وبعدين "treet" وبعدين "street". الأزواج دي بتوري الفرق بين الكلمة بحرف ساكن واحد واتنين.
drills: We scan the structure before we split the slab.
Please confirm the scope and the schedule.
Our strategy is to send the proposal to the client today.
The street is closed, so the truck will use the side entrance.

shadow.en: We scan the structure before drilling.
Let's split the scope into two phases.
The schedule is tight but realistic.
Our strategy is simple: speed and safety.
I'll send the proposal to the client today.
The street is closed for two hours.

lines.en: The client wants to split the project into three phases.
Then we need a new schedule and a revised proposal.
Yes, and we must scan the structure again in phase two.
Is the street access the same?
No, the main street is closed at night, so use the side entrance.

questions.prompt: What needs to happen in phase two?

options: the main street is closed at night

speak.promptAr: اشرح خطة مشروع في 40 ثانية مستخدم 5 كلمات فيها clusters: scope، schedule، split، scan، structure، proposal، strategy.
speak.promptEn: Explain a project plan using cluster words.
speak.useEn: scope, schedule, split, scan, structure, proposal
speak.model: First, we'll confirm the scope with the client. Then we'll split the work into two phases and prepare a realistic schedule. Before any drilling, we scan the structure. I'll send the full proposal by Thursday.

write.taskAr: اكتب 6 كلمات من شغلك فيها clusters (st، sp، sk، pr، kl، tr)، وجملة لكل كلمة، واقراهم بصوت عالي.
write.model:
1. Steel – The steel bars must be scanned.
2. Spray – Spray the surface before repair.
3. Skilled – We need two skilled technicians.
4. Program – The program starts on Sunday.
5. Closed – The site is closed on Friday.
6. Track – We track every job in the sheet.

lessons.goalAr: تنطق آخر الكلمة بوضوح، وتنطق جمع -s صح (/s/ و/z/ و/ɪz/)، علشان ما يحصلش لبس بين مفرد وجمع.

read.title: The end of the word matters
read.text:
In business, the last sound often carries important information: one quotation or two quotations, the invoice or the invoices, work or worked. If the final sound disappears, the meaning changes.

The plural -s has three pronunciations. The rule: after p, t, k, f (sites, checks, roofs); /z/ after voiced sounds and vowels (drawings, jobs, days); and /ɪz/ after s, z, sh, ch, j sounds (prices, changes, finishes).

Keep your voice going to the end of the word, especially when speaking fast.
read.ar: آخر صوت في الكلمة غالبًا فيه معلومة مهمة: مفرد ولا جمع، حاضر ولا ماضي. جمع -s ليه 3 نطقات: /s/ بعد p وt وk وf، و/z/ بعد الأصوات المهتزة والحركات، و/ɪz/ بعد s وz وsh وch وj.

vocab.ex: We have three sites in Riyadh.

pron.explainAr: /s/ بدون اهتزاز (sites)، و/z/ باهتزاز (jobs)، و/ɪz/ مقطع زيادة (prices). وكمان انتبه للحروف الأخيرة زي t وd وk: ما تبلعهاش.
drills: We have three sites and five jobs this week.
Please send the drawings and the invoices.
Prices and changes must be approved.
Safety checks take two days.

shadow.en: Please send the drawings by Sunday.
Three invoices are still overdue.
We finished five jobs on two sites.
Prices changed, so we updated the quotes.
Daily safety checks are required.
There are two changes in the scope.

listen.contextAr: مكالمة متابعة مع مسؤولة الحسابات عند العميل. ركّز على المفرد والجمع.

lines.en: Hi Ahmed, we received the invoice for the Marina site.
Thanks. Actually, we sent three invoices — Marina, Jumeirah and the hotel.
I only see one. Could you resend the other two?
Sure. I'll also attach the drawings and the completion certificates.
Great. Payments are processed on Thursdays.

questions.prompt: How many invoices did Ahmed send?

speak.promptAr: اعمل تحديث أسبوعي في 40 ثانية فيه 6 كلمات جمع على الأقل (sites، jobs، invoices، drawings، prices، changes).
speak.useEn: sites, jobs, invoices, drawings, prices, changes, days
speak.model: This week we worked on four sites and finished seven jobs. We sent five invoices, and two are still pending. The client shared new drawings with three changes, so we updated our prices. We need two more days for the hotel project.

write.taskAr: اكتب تحديث أسبوعي (5 سطور) بالجمع، وعلّم على كل جمع: /s/ ولا /z/ ولا /ɪz/.
write.model:
Weekly update
• 4 sites (/s/) active; 7 jobs (/z/) completed.
• 5 invoices (/ɪz/) sent; 2 pending.
• New drawings (/z/) received with 3 changes (/ɪz/).
• Updated prices (/ɪz/) shared with procurement.
• Safety checks (/s/) completed daily.

lessons.goalAr: تنطق الماضي -ed صح وتقول الأرقام والتواريخ والنسب بوضوح في التقارير.

read.title: Reporting what happened
read.text:
When you report results, you use the past tense and numbers together: "We completed 42 openings and reduced the cycle time by 18 percent." Two things often go wrong: the -ed ending, and numbers.

The -ed ending has three sounds: /t/ after voiceless sounds (finished, checked, asked), /d/ after voiced sounds (delivered, planned, scanned), and /ɪd/ after t and d (completed, started, needed). Only /ɪd/ adds a syllable.

For numbers, say them in groups and stress the important part: "one hundred and forty-two", "eighteen percent", "three point five million". For dates, say "the fifteenth of March" or "March fifteenth".
read.ar: في التقارير بنستخدم الماضي مع الأرقام. -ed ليها 3 نطقات: /t/ وd/ و/ɪd/ (وده بس اللي بيزوّد مقطع). والأرقام قولها مجموعات واضحة، والتواريخ "the fifteenth of March".

pron.explainAr: ما تقولش "ريديوسِد" (reduced = ريديوست). /ɪd/ بس بعد t وd: completed وstarted. والأرقام: الضغط على آخر جزء: one hundred and FORty-TWO.
drills: We completed forty-two openings and reduced the cycle time by eighteen percent.
Revenue increased to three point five million in the third quarter.
We delivered the project on the fifteenth of March.
They started on Sunday and finished on Wednesday.

shadow.en: We completed forty-two openings last month.
We reduced the cycle time by eighteen percent.
Revenue increased to three point five million.
We delivered on the fifteenth of March.
They started on Sunday and finished on Wednesday.
Costs dropped by four point two percent.

lines.en: In the third quarter, we completed one hundred and forty-two jobs.
Revenue increased by twelve percent to three point five million pounds.
We reduced the average quotation time from four days to one point five days.
And collections?
Our DSO dropped from ninety-five to seventy-eight days.

speak.promptAr: اعمل تحديث نتايج شهر في 45 ثانية: 3 أرقام على الأقل (عدد، ونسبة، ومبلغ) و4 أفعال ماضي.
speak.useEn: completed, reduced, increased, delivered, percent, point
speak.model: Last month we completed fifty-six openings on four sites. We delivered every job on time and reduced rework to one point two percent. Revenue increased by nine percent to one point eight million pounds, and we started two new projects on the twentieth.

write.taskAr: اكتب 5 bullets لتقرير شهري بنتايج حقيقية (أو تقريبية) بأرقام وأفعال ماضي، واقراه بصوت عالي.
write.model:
Monthly report – October
• Completed 56 openings across 4 sites.
• Reduced rework to 1.2%.
• Increased revenue by 9% to EGP 1.8 million.
• Delivered all jobs on schedule.
• Started 2 new projects on 20 October.
